answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 13577 Country: India Title: WE ARE DOING A RETAIL READYMADE GARMENT BUSINESS, FOR THE PURPOSE OF ADVERTISEMENT IS THERE A CHANCE TO USE THE GENTS AND LADIES MODELS INSIDE AND OUTSIDE OF OUR SHOP? PLEASE GIVE ME A ANSWER. Question: WE ARE DOING A RETAIL READYMADE GARMENT BUSINESS, FOR THE PURPOSE OF ADVERTISEMENT IS THERE A CHANCE TO USE THE GENTS AND LADIES MODELS INSIDE AND OUTSIDE OF OUR SHOP? PLEASE GIVE ME A ANSWER. Answer ID: 13577 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/709=L/1430) By ?model? if you mean the statue of men and women which is generally kept at garment shops, then it is unlawful as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
